stage: P3, architecture A4: a bounded learned torque correction around the PID
gate: The plan runs A4 only for a distinct tracking gap that remains after estimation has been dealt with, and only after classical feedforward and tuning have been compared.
reason: No such gap was measured. With B7 in the loop and a healthy sensor, the worst clean tracking RMSE over every acceleration case, both noise levels and the car 10 percent heavier than the model is 0.0409 m/s, against a registered bound of 0.1 m/s, and at the noise floor B7 is never more than 0.00001 m/s worse than the filter B5. The tracking errors that are large (1 to 13 m/s) occur while a sensor fault is flagged and the loop is controlling on a drifting fallback speed: that is an estimation error, which a torque correction acting on the same wrong speed cannot remove. Planned profiles in stage P6 were tracked to 0.001 m/s RMSE.
what_would_reopen_it: A measured clean tracking error near the 0.1 m/s bound on the board, or a plant change (tyre, payload, grade) that the feedforward cannot follow.
